\[
\vec d=\begin{pmatrix}2\\-9\\-2\end{pmatrix}.

\[

\[

\begin{pmatrix}-8\\7\\5\end{pmatrix}.
\]

For parallel lines, the distance is
\[
\frac{\|\overrightarrow{AB}\times \vec d\|}{\|\vec d\|}.
\]

=
\begin{pmatrix}-8\\7\\5\end{pmatrix}

\|\vec d\|=\sqrt{2^2+(-9)^2+(-2)^2}=\sqrt{89}.
